about_the_game:
Inspired by a true experience

On a cold winter day, you wake up in a damp patient room with a severe headache. The first thing you find is your own death certificate. The patient rooms are filled with terrible smells and deformed human beings.

As you go deeper, you will never forget what you witness.

The hospital roof is 6 meters below ground level. The only way out is to discover the truth. The only way to learn the truth is to reach the minus fourth floor.

Simple choices have major consequences.

A simple decision you make will determine whether Emily Halloway survives. But to learn the consequences of your choice and, most importantly, who you are, you will have to return to where you started. Because you know... everything ends where it begins.

content_descriptors.notes: This horror game contains psychological thriller elements, violence, and disturbing content. The game features blood, deformed creatures, and medical experiment scenes. Dark atmosphere, jumpscares, and horror elements are present. The game explores themes of memory loss and identity crisis as psychological trauma themes.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 Mojave or higher
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 2.3 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU, 2 GB VRAM (Intel Iris Pro 5200 or better)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: macOS compatible sound card
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or higher
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 2.3 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU, 4 GB VRAM (AMD Radeon Pro or better)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: macOS compatible sound card

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Latest drivers required for AMD and NVIDIA GPUs

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or equivalent

short_description: To escape from a hospital whose roof is underground, you must descend to the deepest level. At every step, you need to endure witnessing the results of horrific experiments. And rest assured, you will never predict the end of the story.
